Terms & Conditions

B2B use only. The Connect Pharma is intended for pharmaceutical businesses, including suppliers/distributors and medical shops. It is not a consumer medicine store. Users must provide accurate business and account information and may use the platform only for lawful business purposes.

Business credentials and review

Email verification confirms access to an email address; it does not verify a Drug Licence, GST registration, pharmacist credential or business identity. Users may submit business documents for manual administrative review. Such review is not an independent government-registry check and does not guarantee legal validity, completeness or current status. Each business remains responsible for maintaining valid licences, registrations, authorisations and records required by law.

Regulated medicines and records

Suppliers must not offer or supply prescription medicines to unauthorised buyers. Schedule H, H1, X and other regulated medicines may be handled only by appropriately licensed and authorised businesses and in accordance with applicable Indian drug laws. Buyers and suppliers are responsible for checking the other party’s authority, product classification, prescription requirements and all applicable restrictions before any transaction.

Businesses must maintain complete product, batch, expiry, order, supply and statutory records required for their activities. The platform records selected account, administrative, enquiry and payment events; it is not represented as a complete statutory medicines register or audit system.

Listings, prices and transactions

Listings, prices, stock, discounts and comparison figures may be sample or indicative and can become outdated. They are not a guarantee of availability or a binding offer. Buyers and suppliers must confirm product identity, composition, strength, dosage form, pack size, MRP, applicable GST, scheme, stock, batch and expiry details directly before agreeing to a transaction. The parties are responsible for final terms and lawful fulfilment.

Subscriptions and payment

Current paid plans are charged for one 30-day period and require a new payment for renewal. Automatic renewal reminders, recurring charges, SKU-limit enforcement and GST invoice generation are not currently provided by this application. See the subscription page for current billing information.

Applicable law

Users must comply with applicable Indian drug, pharmacy, tax, consumer-protection and data-protection laws. These terms describe platform expectations and are not legal advice or a certification of regulatory compliance.

For questions, contact connectpharma@gmail.com.
